import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.optim as optim
# ... (Data Loading) ...

# Define the CNN Model (No pretrained layers)
class CNNModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super(CNNModel, self).__init__()
        self.conv1 = nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.conv2 = nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1)
        self.pool = nn.MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(64 * 8 * 8, 128)  # 64*8*8 = 4096
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 10)
        self.relu = nn.ReLU()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.relu(self.conv1(x))
        x = self.pool(x)
        x = self.relu(self.conv2(x))
        x = self.pool(x)
        x = x.view(x.size(0), -1)
        x = self.relu(self.fc1(x))
        x = self.fc2(x)
        return x

# ... (Training Loop) ...

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from flax import linen as nn
import optax

# Define the CNN Model
class CNNModel(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        x = nn.relu(nn.Conv2d(32, (3, 3), padding='same')(x))
        x = nn.max_pool(nn.relu(nn.Conv2d(64, (3, 3), padding='same')(x)), (2, 2))
        x = x.reshape((x.shape[0], -1))
        x = nn.relu(nn.Dense(128)(x))
        x = nn.Dense(10)(x)
        return x

# Initialize the model, loss function, and optimizer
model = CNNModel()
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()
optimizer = optax.adam(learning_rate=0.001)

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from flax import linen as nn
import optax

# Define the CNN Model
class CNNModel(nn.Module):
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x):
        # 1. First Conv + ReLU + Pool
        x = nn.Conv(features=32, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.max_pool(x, window_shape=(2, 2), strides=(2, 2))

        # 2. Second Conv + ReLU + Pool
        x = nn.Conv(features=64, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.max_pool(x, window_shape=(2, 2), strides=(2, 2))

        # 3. Flatten and Dense Layers
        x = x.reshape((x.shape[0], -1))
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dense(features=10)(x)
        return x

# ... (Training Loop) ...

Errors.Error: Architecture Mismatch. The Input PyTorch code applies pooling *after* each convolution layer (Conv1 -> ReLU -> Pool -> Conv2 -> ReLU -> Pool). The Raw JAX code misses the first pooling layer entirely and only pools after the second convolution, altering the spatial dimensions and receptive field.
Errors.Fix_info: Insert a max pooling layer after the first convolution block to match the PyTorch architecture.
Errors.Fixed_Code: x = nn.max_pool(x, window_shape=(2, 2), strides=(2, 2)) # After Conv1

Errors.Error: AttributeError. `nn.CrossEntropyLoss` is a PyTorch class. Flax/JAX do not have this class; they use functional losses.

Data Layout Mismatch. PyTorch uses `(N, C, H, W)`. JAX uses `(N, H, W, C)` for convolutions by default. The generated data is in NCHW format, which will cause JAX convolutions to interpret the channel dimension '3' as height/width.
Errors.Fix_info: Generate data in `(N, H, W, C)` format or transpose it.
